The Serum acts at the very source of biological performance recalibrating the skin’s natural functions. This transformative cream-to-water serum works on three levels, revitalizing skin’s appearance, refining texture, and revealing translucent radiance.Exclusively available on prada.com and at selected retailers.
details: Hyaluronic acid (Low molecular weight) to recharge skin volume, smooth out texture and enhance skin’s volume and density.
Optimal concentration of peptides for collagen and elastin synthesis.
Squalane with its antioxidant properties to even skin tone and reveal a translucent radiance

products.title: Prada Augmented Skin - The Essence

details: The Adapto.gn Micro-Peel Technology™, to prep, optimize and exfoliate.

products.officialNameEn: Prada Augmented Skin - Eye Cream - NEUTRI
products.title: Prada Augmented Skin - Eye Cream - NEUTRI
products.description: This transformative balm-to-serum eye cream offers a 3-dimensional eye care: skin feels tightened, brightness looks revived and lines appear smoothed.
details: AAA [Amino Acids-Ashwagandha] Technology™: proven to boost collagen production +420% (in vitro test on collagen III based on actives)
1% Caffeine: helps to address dark circles under the eyes, to reduce the appearance of eye bags and puffiness, and to illuminate eye contour.
Iris root extract: natural origin ingredient to help provide a revitalizing glow and firmer eye contour area.
Encapsulated Hyaluronic Acid : encapsulated H.A. form to fill in fine lines & wrinkles and smooth out eye skin texture.

products.title: Prada Paradoxe Hand Cream
products.description: A daily gesture becomes identity. Prada Paradoxe Hand captures the signature Paradoxe scent in an on-the-go format: floral, ambery, vibrant. An invitation to reinvent self-care, balancing delicacy and strength.

products.title: Prada Hand cream
products.description: A lightweight yet intensely caring formula defines the Prada hand cream, enriched with revitalizing iris. It smooths the skin, nourishes cuticles, and strengthens nails, leaving hands protected.

products.title: Large Re-Nylon travel pouch
products.description: Characterized by a sleek line and emphasized by the iconic enameled metal triangle logo, this travel pouch is made of Prada's innovative Re-Nylon fabric produced from recycled plastic materials collected in the ocean. The practical and versatile accessory is accented with zipper pockets inside and out. For sustainable care to preserve the product's characteristics and reduce microfiber shedding, we recommend not washing the item too often. Let the product air out after every use and have it dry cleaned at a specialized ecological dry cleaners.
details: Three outer pockets, one with zipper
Re-Nylon lining with three pockets, one with zipper
